persons.name: Śeravāhādura
persons.evidence: nṛpavaratanayaḥ seravāhā duroʼ sāv etenaivārcita śrīraghukulatilakasyāśiṣāṃ pātram āstām

relations.evidence: vidhim alikhid imaṃ rāmacaṃdrārcanasya | rādhākṛṣṇō dvijanmā nṛpavaratanayaḥ seravāhā duroʼ sāv etenaivārcita

date.as_written: śrīśāke vahninetrāvalarāśisumite caitrike śuklapakṣe paṃcamyāṃ saumyavāre

purpose: for Śeravāhādura to perform the worship and receive the blessings of Rāmacandra (śrīraghukulatilakasyāśiṣāṃ pātram āstām)
notes: Seravāhādura (Śer Bahādur Śāha, son of King Pratap Singh Shah) is addressed as 'nṛpavaratanaya'. The chronogram 'vahninetrāvalarāśi' likely encodes Śaka 1723 (Caitra śukla 5, Wednesday corresponds to 18 March 1801 CE).
